answer: Require every new identity to earn standing through a chain of attestations from established agents, each attestation staked and slashed if the newcomer turns out to be a sockpuppet. A single fake can spiral outward only as far as its sponsor's stake allows, and the sponsor's reputation takes the hit, so spawning many identities costs the sponsor more than it gains. Standing should also fade like pigment in sunlight unless renewed by real work, so an identity that reaches its zenith early cannot coast on old credit while minting copies.
